response.sql:
WITH scan_rates AS (
  SELECT
    sites.healtheval,
    scans.gbsize / scans.spanmin AS rate
  FROM scans
  JOIN sites ON scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry
  WHERE scans.gbsize IS NOT NULL
    AND scans.spanmin IS NOT NULL
    AND scans.spanmin > 0
),
status_stats AS (
  SELECT
    healtheval,
    AVG(rate) AS avg_rate,
    COUNT(*) AS num_scans
  FROM scan_rates
  GROUP BY healtheval
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS overall_avg FROM status_stats
),
filtered_statuses AS (
  SELECT
    ss.avg_rate,
    ss.num_scans,
    oa.overall_avg
  FROM status_stats ss
  CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
  WHERE oa.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
    AND ss.avg_rate > oa.overall_avg
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_rate) AS average_rate,
  AVG(num_scans) AS average_count,
  AVG(avg_rate - overall_avg) AS average_excess
FROM filtered_statuses

assumptions.assumption: "average count" refers to the average number of scan records per health/safety status group, not the average of scans.scancount field values
Scans with NULL gbsize, NULL spanmin, or spanmin ≤ 0 are excluded from rate calculations per "ignoring missing values"
If the overall average rate is NULL (no valid status groups exist), the result is an empty set per "none if that average is missing"

alternatives.interpretation: "average count" refers to the average of the scans.scancount field (number of individual scans in each set) within each status group
